It shows that ₹499 already sits on the line where refusals drop from 29% to 17%, and it costs the leak correctly at about ₹1.04 lakh a month (6,880 orders under ₹499, 40% COD, 29% refused, ₹130 each). o1.biggest_mistake: The opening 'bad news' block crams in break-even counts and lakh ranges before I know what the bundles are, so it is hard to follow on a first read. The face wash + serum pair is only offered as a three-item set, with no plain duo.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Explain the bundles first, then the money, in plainer words. Put each bundle's profit and break-even next to its name. Make the bundle copy warmer and more playful, closer to Plum's cheerful voice.

o2.biggest_mistake: The case for moving to ₹599 rests on assuming only 6% of orders fall between ₹499 and ₹598. My data puts 27% of orders in the ₹500 to 699 band, so that slice is more likely 12 to 14%, and the profit figure may be off. It also mostly ignores COD refusals in the threshold decision.
